completion_promises.criterion_text: Mic button joins the input row behind `_sending`/`_ended`; press-to-record, press-to-send with an elapsed indicator; **one turn at a time** — pressing mic while a send is in flight does nothing.
completion_promises.evidence: Added mic button to SessionScreen input row with Icons.mic/Icons.stop states, _recording flag, elapsed indicator (_formatElapsed()), and onPressed guard that prevents interaction when _sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable. _toggleMic() handles press-to-record and press-to-send logic.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On send, the transcript enters the session list **first**, exactly like a typed turn, then the tutor's spoken answer follows.
completion_promises.evidence: _sendVoiceTurn() adds transcript to _turns as user TurnEntry first (line ~219), then adds tutor answer as second TurnEntry (line ~222), preserving exact order.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `VoiceUnavailable` → amber notice with the verbatim copy *"Spoken answers aren't available right now — text still works"*; the mic stays **visible but disabled for the rest of the session** until a retry succeeds; typed turns are unaffected.
completion_promises.evidence: VoiceUnavailable catch block sets _voiceUnavailable=true and _voiceErrorMessage with exact copy (line ~229-232). Build method renders amber Container when _voiceUnavailable (line ~319-327). Mic button remains visible but onPressed is null when _voiceUnavailable (line ~349).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Transport error keeps the existing `showConnectionProblem` treatment — recording preserved, retry = resend.
completion_promises.evidence: TransportError catch in _sendVoiceTurn() calls showConnectionProblem(context) (line ~257-260), preserving existing error handling pattern. Recording data is not cleared, allowing retry.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Recording without microphone permission explains it needs mic access and **does not fail** — typing still works.
completion_promises.evidence: Try-catch in _toggleMic() around recorder.start() catches permission errors and sets _voiceErrorMessage='This app needs microphone access to record your questions' (line ~166-170). Typing functionality unchanged.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Each refusal error type surfaces a plain-terms message and the app stays ready to record again immediately.
completion_promises.evidence: Catch blocks for all 5 refusal errors (UnsupportedAudioFormat line ~233-237, EmptyRecording line ~238-242, UnintelligibleQuery line ~243-247, QueryTooLong line ~248-252, RecordingTooLarge line ~253-256) each set plain-terms _voiceErrorMessage. completion_promises.criterion_text: The mic is disabled along with the rest of the input once the session has ended.
completion_promises.evidence: Mic button onPressed uses guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable) ? null : _toggleMic (line ~349), ensuring mic is disabled when _ended flag is set by _endSession().
